candidate.title: G&T-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned middle G&T-Seq row, captioned Genome and transcriptome sequencing from a single cell (G&T-seq): physical separation of bead-captured polyA RNA from genomic DNA, on-bead Smart-Seq2 transcriptome amplification, and the depicted MDA DNA branch, followed by separate sequencing and associated RNA/genome alignments. Smart-Seq2 and MDA are embedded components. The independent DR-Seq and scM&T-Seq rows visible above and below are adjacent poster context, not alternative G&T-Seq routes. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete experimental recipe or a claim about all G&T-Seq implementations.

states.label: G&T-Seq amplified transcript-derived cDNA

The G&T-Seq primary abstract identifies full-length mRNA as the biological target; the schematic does not claim every transcript is recovered or every sequencing read spans a full transcript.
